description: Simulate an EVM transaction BEFORE signing: catches reverts via eth_call at pending state, decodes the reason (Error(string), Panic codes, or the raw selector for custom errors), and returns a buffered gas estimate usable as gasLimit. Also flags calls that return boolean false without reverting (some ERC-20s signal failure that way). An unreachable node returns 'unavailable', never 'would fail'. A pass reflects current chain state and is not a guarantee the transaction lands.

tx.description: { from, to, data, value } — value in wei.

name: evm_simulate_transaction
